definitions.explanation: A raised platform or stand from which a person delivers a speech, lecture, or presentation.

examples.japanese: {演壇|えんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{演壇|えんだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The chairperson gave a greeting from the podium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{演壇|えんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧{始|はじ}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いて→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧きた。
examples.english: I nervously stepped up to the podium, but once I started speaking I calmed down.

notes:
A compound of {演|えん} (perform/speech) and ⟦{壇|だん}→壇：23016_dan⟧ (platform/stage). Refers to the raised area or stand where a speaker addresses an audience.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演壇|えんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the podium
- {演壇|えんだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to go up to the podium
- {演壇|えんだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to step down from the podium
- {演壇|えんだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演説|えんぜつ}→演説：01894_enzetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a speech at the podium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{壇上|だんじょう}→壇上：21719_danjou⟧: on the stage/platform — refers to the area itself rather than the specific speaking stand
- ⟦{講壇|こうだん}→講壇：24169_koudan⟧: lecture platform — specifically for academic lectures
- ⟦{縁談|えんだん}→縁談：13847_endan⟧: marriage proposal — a homophone with an unrelated meaning
